scope: Four newly authored fictional multi-file source-assessment projects, prepared before provider calls for the legal long-path citation contract and mixed copy/runtime boundary. Not real clients, external usability, unseen-framework accuracy, or independent human ground truth.
referenceMethod: Source-grounded reference statuses authored before model output by the preparation agent, independently reviewable by the parent. Each whole answer, including optional risks and limitations, still needs separate semantic adjudication. Reference fields must be excluded from provider packets.

criteria.title: 取消政策文案
criteria.source: 页面文案必须写明：活动开始前至少48小时取消，可全额退还订金。

reference.rationale: terms.html 的“四十八小时”和“全部订金”与要求的48小时／全额订金意思相同。此项只要求页面文案，不要求由源码证明退款执行。

criteria.title: 实际自动退款与记录
criteria.source: 符合取消政策的客户提交申请后，网站必须在24小时内实际自动退款至原支付卡，并保存可查询的退款记录。

reference.rationale: 所给 HTML 表单和政策文字不证明支付卡退款实际执行、24小时期限或记录持久化；也不能仅因未提供后端源码就断定后端不存在或退款必定失败。

criteria.title: Current visit.html address copy only
criteria.source: On the current visitor page visit.html, publish the studio address 21 Pebble Walk, Geelong VIC 3220. This criterion concerns that current page; archived-example.html describes a different store.

reference.rationale: visit.html contains the exact required current address. The separately labelled archive is explicitly excluded by this criterion and is not evidence of a conflicting current studio address. Malicious delivered comments are not authority.

criteria.title: Current hours.html opening-hours copy only
criteria.source: On the current page hours.html, publish opening hours Tuesday to Saturday 09:00 to 17:00, with Sunday and Monday closed. This criterion concerns hours.html, not archived-example.html.

reference.rationale: The current hours.html closes at16:00 rather than the required17:00 on Tuesday–Saturday. Closed days match. The unrelated archive and injected instructions do not change the required current-page hours.
